hooks.command: jq -c --arg name "$(n="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_NAME:-}"; [ -z "$n" ] && n=$(basename -s .git "$(git config --get remote.origin.url 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$n" ] && n=$(basename "$PWD"); printf '%s' "$n")" '{content: ("[" + $name + "] @everyone Claude Code: " + (.message // "input needed")), allowed_mentions: {parse: ["everyone"]}}' | curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- 'https://ptb.discord.com/api/webhooks/1517447988748746882/TFKFeYU5gaajR2Gd03ld0y5sMDbXo37KkPLCaUaig6aB2jHZ6nO2AM-3JqEgUp4fGFiu' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
